rics.description: Existing-Home Sales, Single-Family and Condos, median price
rics.meaning: Level of US existing home sales.
rics.how_to_use: NAR monthly. ~5x larger than new home sales. Heavily rate-sensitive (most buyers have a low rate to give up). Months-supply is the tight/loose gauge.

rics.description: FHFA House Price Index- Actual, Chg P/P
rics.meaning: FHFA HPI MoM change.
rics.how_to_use: Annualize for comparison: 0.4% MoM ≈ 5% YoY. Volatile single months; 3-month MA cleaner.

rics.description: FHFA House Price Index- Actual, Chg Y/Y
rics.meaning: FHFA House Price Index YoY change. Federal Housing Finance Agency — covers conforming-loan-only properties (≤$766k limit in most areas).
rics.how_to_use: Cleaner than Case-Shiller in distress periods (excludes jumbo, all-cash). Different sample = different reads sometimes. Watch alongside Case-Shiller; if they diverge, jumbo segment is moving differently from conforming.
